messages:
Noelle: Dropping a slightly different iteration of the Roles + Org settings header. Main focus: clarify SSO wording in-context (not just the toggle), improve mobile tap targets for Invite actions, and introduce deep-links to Audit entries in the table. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/unique-roles-v4 (frame: roles-header-v4).

Ethan: Love the deep-link idea. If the audit rows link to specific events, we should add a small chevron and an aria-label like `Open audit event details` so screen reader users know it's a link. Also, deep-links need stable IDs from the backend. I'll add an API note.

Priya: Accessibility: mobile tap target sizes are important here. For the compact toolbar, keep minimum 44px hit area even if the visible icon is 24px. Also when Invite modal opens, focus must land on the role select, then to the email input. Add aria-live when an import completes: `Import complete: 42 users added`.

Liam: Copy question: the current helper line reads `Require SSO for org`. Customers misread it. My proposal: primary label `Require SSO sign-in` and two-line help: `Disables password login. Managed in Security 12 SSO. Learn more`. Alternative variant: `Enforce SSO sign-in for all members` (longer but explicit). Which do we prefer?

Hannah: Preference for `Require SSO sign-in` as a short label, with the help text clarifying disables passwords. Also, suggestion: when toggled on, show a small inline confirmation panel that lists affected groups and if any non-SSO users exist, a warning row with a `Resolve now` CTA. That reduces surprise.

Noelle: Good call, Hannah. Actionable changes I'm planning: - Switch label to `Require SSO sign-in` + helper text `Disables password login. Manage IdP in Security 12 SSO.` - Add confirmation panel after toggle that lists how many users will be forced to sign in via SSO and a `View affected users` deep-link to the Audit+Users list. - Ensure mobile hit targets >=44px and desktop icon-only states still have aria-labels and visible focus ring.

Ethan: For CSV import UX: show progress states in the header chip with `Uploading...`, `Processing (42/128)`, `Completed: 128 users` and expose a small `Cancel` action while processing. Also surface a final audit link to the import event so admins can inspect which rows failed.

Priya: ARIA snippets to include in PR: `<button aria-label="View affected users (opens in audit)"></button>` and `role="status" aria-live="polite"` for async import updates. Also require contrast checks for the inline confirmation panel (min 4.5:1 for body copy).

Liam: Microcopy: change `Grant` -> `Assign` across the flows, and use `Require SSO sign-in` as the canonical label in docs. Update translations note on the ticket for i18n because that helper text will grow in length in other languages.

Hannah: UX nit: on small screens, the confirmation panel after toggling SSO should be full-width and dismissible with an `X` and `Esc`. It should also include a clear `Undo` and `View rollback steps` link.

copy-bot: SUGGESTION: Reword help line to: `Disables password login. Configure identity provider in Security > SSO. Learn more` (shorter, action-first). Added to the copy-sweep checklist.

Noelle: Thanks everyone. I'll update the Figma with the confirmation panel, CSV progress chip, deep-link icons, and the label change. I'll add ARIA snippets and the mobile hit target spec to the ticket and ping infra about stable audit event IDs. Will post updated prototype link by EOD. Ping me if you want to pair on the i18n length check. :shipit:
